loggingSettings.description: Proxy-wide settings that control how request and response data are written to spend logs.

storePrompts.hint: When enabled, prompts will be stored in spend logs for tracking and analysis purposes.

retentionPeriod.label: Maximum Spend Logs Retention Period (Optional)
retentionPeriod.hint: Set the maximum retention period for spend logs (e.g., '7d' for 7 days, '30d' for 30 days). Leave empty for no limit.

cleanupBatchSize.label: Spend Logs Cleanup Batch Size (Optional)
cleanupBatchSize.hint: Rows deleted per DELETE statement during cleanup. Leave empty to use the default of 1000.

cleanupMaxBatches.label: Spend Logs Cleanup Max Batches (Optional)
cleanupMaxBatches.hint: Maximum number of DELETE statements run per table per cleanup run. Leave empty to use the default of 500.

cleanupRunBudget.label: Spend Logs Cleanup Run Budget (Optional)
cleanupRunBudget.hint: Wall-clock budget for a whole cleanup run, shared across every table it cleans (e.g., '5m'). Leave empty to use the default of 5m.

cleanupBatchTimeout.label: Spend Logs Cleanup Batch Timeout (Optional)
cleanupBatchTimeout.hint: Postgres statement and lock timeout applied to each cleanup batch, so cleanup never monopolizes a connection (e.g., '30s'). Leave empty to use the default of 30s.
